Variants.Content: Following Cannae, Capua, Italy's second wealthiest city, defected to Hannibal in the ambition of supplanting Rome as master of Italy. However, Carthaginian winter quarters in luxuriant Capua dissipated the razor-sharp edge of Hannibal's mercenary forces. Capua's betrayal prompted waves of rebellions across Samnium, Lucania, and Magna Graecia, straining Rome's alliance network to the brink.
